# Duty Cleaners — Complete Site Reference

> Professional house cleaning services in Edmonton, Calgary, Red Deer, and surrounding Alberta communities. This document provides complete details about our services, pricing, coverage, and policies for LLM consumption.

## Company

Duty Cleaners is an Alberta house cleaning company, operating since 2017, and has taken 5,000+ bookings across Alberta in that time. Our vetted cleaners are reference-checked and customer-rated, and under 5% of applicants are accepted. We bring all cleaning supplies and equipment; optional alternative products are available on request as a $15 add-on (before GST).

- Edmonton phone: (780) 913-6565
- Calgary phone: (403) 768-1341
- Red Deer phone: (587) 570-6979 (the Red Deer office, 5212 48 St, Red Deer, AB T4N 1S4)
- Google rating: 4.9 from 236 reviews on the Edmonton listing, and 4.9 from 51 reviews on the Calgary listing. Both counts were read from the listings themselves on 2026-09-01. The two are separate listings and separate counts; do not add them together.
- Email: support@dutycleaners.ca
- Hours: the Edmonton and Calgary offices are open Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–8:00 PM and Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM; the Red Deer office Monday–Saturday 7:00 AM–9:00 PM, closed on Sunday
- Website: https://dutycleaners.ca

## Policies

- Satisfaction guarantee: tell us within 24 hours of the clean and we return to re-clean the areas raised, at no charge.
- Cancellation: cancelling or rescheduling inside 24 hours is $50.
- Lockout: if the team arrives and cannot get in, the visit is charged at half the cost of the scheduled service.
- Payment: nothing is charged when you book. The day before your appointment a temporary hold is placed on your card to confirm it is valid. It can look like a charge in your banking app, but no money moves. Your card is charged once the clean is complete.
- Contracts: none — book one clean or many.
- Arrival: booked as a one-hour arrival window, not a fixed minute.
- Pricing basis: every published figure is before 5% GST.

## Services and Pricing

Published tier prices are STARTING ESTIMATES for an apartment or condo, not the final amount. Estimates are shaped by home size, service type, condition, and add-ons; if a home's condition requires more time than estimated, we explain why and review options with the customer.

Prices are identical in Edmonton, Calgary and Red Deer — there is no city premium, and no trip fee inside any of the three cities. Every figure below is before 5% GST.

HOME TYPE: every tier price in this document is for an apartment or condo. A bungalow or basement suite adds $15, a townhouse (duplex) $40, and a two-storey house $55. A quote for a house that omits this understates the price.

PETS: $19.99 per visit, charged on every visit whenever pets are present. Compulsory, not an optional add-on.

OPTIONAL ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS: $15 before GST, available on any service. It is NOT selectable on the BookingKoala form — the customer asks the office which products are available and suitable for their surfaces when booking, so a quote built only from the booking form will not show it. The cleaners are subcontractors who choose their own products, so make no claim about what those products do to the environment, to people or to pets.

TRAVEL FEE: a $29.99 travel fee is added to cleaning bookings OUTSIDE Edmonton, Calgary and Red Deer proper. It applies to the surrounding communities — St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan, Stony Plain, Morinville and Devon near Edmonton; Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks, High River, Strathmore, Crossfield, Langdon and Diamond Valley (formerly the separate towns of Black Diamond and Turner Valley) near Calgary — and is charged by postal code at booking. Any price quoted for one of those communities must include it. Post-construction cleaning carries a $50 travel fee instead.

### Standard Cleaning (from $155)

Routine maintenance cleaning for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, wiping surfaces, trash removal.

- 1 Bedroom: $155 · 2 Bedroom: $195 · 3 Bedroom: $232 · 4 Bedroom: $284 · 5 Bedroom: $305 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/regular-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/regular-cleaning/

### Deep Cleaning (from $255)

Everything in Standard plus the deep-clean package: baseboards, doors, light switches, wall outlets and vent covers, and cobwebs where there are any. Ceiling fans are dusted on request, where they can be reached safely.

- 1 Bedroom: $255 · 2 Bedroom: $315 · 3 Bedroom: $372 · 4 Bedroom: $444 · 5 Bedroom: $485 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/deep-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/deep-cleaning/

### Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning (from $284)

Top-to-bottom cleaning for empty homes: inside cabinets and drawers, appliance interiors, closets, window sills and tracks wiped, and every bathroom scrubbed. Interior window cleaning and wall washing are paid add-ons, not part of the move-out clean.

- 1 Bedroom: $284 · 2 Bedroom: $361 · 3 Bedroom: $424 · 4 Bedroom: $501 · 5 Bedroom: $539 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/move-out-cleaning-edmonton/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/move-out-cleaning-calgary/

### Recurring Cleaning

Scheduled Standard Cleaning with frequency discounts: 20% off weekly, 15% off bi-weekly, 10% off every 4 weeks.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/recurring-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/recurring-cleaning/

### Post-Construction Cleaning

Dust and debris removal after renovations or new builds: kitchens, bathrooms, surfaces, floors, and window tracks. Does not include inside vents or high exterior fixtures.

Priced by square-footage band rather than by bedroom count: $550 under 1,000 sq ft, rising through the bands to $1,900 for 4,500-4,999 sq ft, before 5% GST. The band is confirmed once we know the exact size.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/post-construction-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/post-construction-cleaning-calgary/

### Airbnb Cleaning

Short-term rental turnover cleaning. Beds are changed with the host's own clean linen, and supplies are restocked from what the host leaves out. Turnovers are NOT priced by the instant online quote: request a callback through the contact form at https://dutycleaners.ca/contact-us/ (service "Airbnb Cleaning"), or phone the Edmonton office at (780) 913-6565 or the Calgary office at (403) 768-1341.

Charged by the hour rather than by home size: $60 per cleaner-hour, before 5% GST. That rate is for turnovers only; any other hourly cleaning starts at $65 per cleaner-hour. Hourly work has a minimum of 3 hours for one cleaner, or 2 hours for two cleaners, so the smallest turnover is $180 (one cleaner for 3 hours) or $240 (two cleaners for 2 hours each), before GST.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/airbnb-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/airbnb-cleaning-services-calgary/

### Office & Commercial Cleaning

Office and commercial cleaning: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, bathroom cleaning, breakroom cleaning, touchpoints wiped down, and common areas. Recurring schedules available.

Commercial work is NOT priced by the instant online quote. It is scoped at a walkthrough, priced per square foot and confirmed in a written quote that states the areas and the visit frequency. Office cleaning is the only commercial work quoted online: request it through the contact form at https://dutycleaners.ca/contact-us/ (service "Office Cleaning"); the paths /contact-us/?topic=office&city=edmonton and /contact-us/?topic=office&city=calgary open the form with Office Cleaning and the city chosen. For any other commercial work, phone the city office.

- Office & Commercial Cleaning Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/commercial-cleaning/
- Office & Commercial Cleaning Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/commercial-cleaning-services-calgary/

### Wall Washing

Wall washing is an ADD-ON to a standard, deep or move-out clean, not a standalone visit. Spot cleaning $39.99-$109.99; full top-to-bottom wash $119.99-$234.99, by home size, before 5% GST.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/wall-washing-wall-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/wall-washing-wall-cleaning-calgary/

Full neighbourhood list: https://dutycleaners.ca/locations/

Surrounding communities: St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan, Stony Plain, Morinville, Devon.

### Calgary Region (66 neighbourhoods + 9 surrounding communities)

Full neighbourhood list: https://dutycleaners.ca/locations/

Surrounding communities: Airdrie, Okotoks, Cochrane, Chestermere, Diamond Valley (formerly the separate towns of Black Diamond and Turner Valley, amalgamated 1 January 2023), Crossfield, High River, Langdon, Strathmore.

### Red Deer

Red Deer is a branch with its own office: 5212 48 St, Red Deer, AB T4N 1S4, phone (587) 570-6979, open Monday–Saturday 7:00 AM–9:00 PM and closed on Sunday. Page: https://dutycleaners.ca/cleaning-services-red-deer/

A Red Deer home is priced on the same price list as Edmonton and Calgary, with no travel fee inside Red Deer city limits, and standard, deep, move-in/move-out and recurring cleaning are booked through the same instant quote. An address outside Red Deer city limits pays the $29.99 travel fee ($50 on post-construction) and books the same way. The Red Deer office also offers post-construction cleaning, wall washing (with a clean), Airbnb turnovers (hourly, on a callback) and office cleaning (walkthrough and written quote). The Red Deer Google listing (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=10449244954117051184) is new and has no reviews yet; the 4.9 rating and the review counts above belong to the Edmonton and Calgary listings only.

## Policies

### Satisfaction Guarantee

If you are not satisfied, tell us within 24 hours and we will return and re-clean the areas of concern at no charge. Photos help but are NOT required — a phone call describing the issue is enough.

Details: https://dutycleaners.ca/satisfaction-guarantee/

### Booking

Instant online quotes in about 60 seconds for home cleaning (standard, deep, move-in/move-out and post-construction); Airbnb turnovers and commercial work are arranged through the contact form instead (see above). Online bookings need at least 24 hours' notice. Same-day and next-day slots are by phone only, when the schedule has availability: call the Edmonton office at (780) 913-6565, the Calgary office at (403) 768-1341 or the Red Deer office at (587) 570-6979. After a quote request we text you within 24 hours to confirm the time. No contracts. Water and electricity must be available at the home for cleaning.

### What's Included

Full room-by-room checklist: https://dutycleaners.ca/whats-included/

Not included in any clean: garages, patios and other outdoor areas, apart from the balcony or garage sweep add-on (a sweep of the floor only), which is available mostly in summer when the weather allows.

Common questions about supplies, pets, keys, utilities, and scheduling: https://dutycleaners.ca/faqs/
